At FintechOS, we are looking for a Sales Operations Lead who wants to build, influence, and leave a visible mark. • Influence at the right level: partner with senior commercial leaders on forecasting, planning, performance, and go-to-market decisions.

 Build the sales operating system: Create scalable processes and cadences that help sellers prioritise the right accounts, progress complex opportunities, and execute consistently.
 Make HubSpot work for sellers: Own CRM architecture, pipeline design, workflows, automation, integrations, reporting, data governance, and adoption.

 Lead meaningful change: Take operational improvements from idea through implementation, enablement, adoption, and measurable impact.
What you will bring
8+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Commercial Operations, ideally within enterprise B2B SaaS.
Advanced HubSpot experience across CRM architecture, pipeline design, automation, reporting, integrations, data governance, and user adoption.
Experience supporting long, high-value sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers, procurement, legal, security, and executive stakeholders.
Hands-on ownership of forecasting, pipeline governance, territory planning, quota setting, or capacity planning.
Strong knowledge of ARR, ACV, bookings, pipeline coverage, win rate, sales velocity, and quota attainment.
Strong analytical and modelling skills using Excel or Google Sheets, plus Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools.
A track record of simplifying sales processes and improving seller productivity without sacrificing commercial discipline.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively.
Great to have
Experience in fintech, banking technology, insurance technology, payments, or another regulated industry.
Familiarity with MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, Challenger, or another enterprise sales methodology.
Experience with Gong, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Clari, or similar platforms.
Experience improving deal-desk, pricing, compensation, or partner-led sales processes.
You will know you are making an impact when
Sellers know where to focus and how to move opportunities forward.
HubSpot is valued as a selling tool, not treated as an administrative obligation.
Pipeline and forecast conversations are consistent, focused, and actionable.
Managers have the insight they need to coach effectively.
Commercial approvals and internal handoffs are faster and more predictable.
The sales operating model scales confidently with the business.
Who we are
FintechOS is a global fintech enablement company on a mission to make financial innovation accessible to every business. Our platform helps banks, insurers, and other financial institutions launch and scale financial products faster, bringing new solutions to market in as little as 12 weeks.

Leaders have reliable, consistent, and timely analytical visibility.

About Extend: 
Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.
Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.
 About The Role 
Our Growth & Sales teams hear something new from merchants every day: a coverage gap that cost us a deal, a feature our partners keep asking for, a trend in the data nobody has acted on yet. The way we win is by connecting those signals and turning them into something that will grow revenue for Extend and our merchant partners.
We are looking for a GTM Strategy & Program Manager to own that feedback loop for a portfolio of retail verticals. You will listen to what our merchant partners want and need, decide what is worth building, drive the right teams to build it in a scalable way, and make sure your Pod knows exactly how to sell it. Your success shows up in new deals won, existing partnerships grown, and stronger margins on both.
This is a role for someone who presents ideas without hesitation, can hold a room with leaders, and never settles for not knowing the answer.
 What You’ll Do 
 Own the feedback loop. Run a regular cadence with Sales, Growth and Analytics to pull together merchant feedback, win/loss reasons and performance data, and turn it into a clear, prioritized view of what we need to build to win more.
 Grow the top and bottom line. Find the opportunities that win new merchants and expand existing partnerships, and build the business case for each one in terms of revenue and margin impact.
 Turn merchant needs into scalable solutions. Listen to what our partners are asking for and shape it into products, features and program offerings that work across your verticals, not one-off custom builds.
 Run the project plan. Set scope, milestones and owners for every initiative, hold teams accountable to deadlines, and raise risks early when something starts to slip.
 Know exactly what is being built. Understand every feature well enough to explain how it works, who it is for and where its limits are, from requirements through launch.
 Enable your Pod. Equip your vertical Pod with the playbooks, talk tracks and training they need to sell and use each new feature, and track adoption after launch.
 Present with conviction. Pitch new ideas to cross-functional partners, executives and leadership, back your recommendations with data, and drive the decision.
 Go find the answer. When a question comes up that nobody can answer, dig into the data, the contracts or the market yourself and come back with the answer and a recommendation.
 Required Qualifications 
 Relevant experience. 5+ years in GTM Strategy, BizOps, or a similar cross-functional role at a fast-paced tech company.
 Ownership from idea to launch. You have taken an initiative from a customer or partner need through build, launch and enablement, and can point to the commercial results.
 Project management discipline. You run several initiatives in parallel, set realistic plans and keep cross-functional teams on deadline without being chased.
 Executive presence. You put ideas in front of people early and often, present to executives with conviction, and hold your ground when you have the data to back it up.
 A numbers-first mindset. Advanced Excel and strong analytical skills. You size opportunities, build models and root your recommendations in data.
 Relentless curiosity. You do not accept "we don't know" as an answer. You go dig it up and report back.
 An AI-native way of working. You already use AI tools like Claude to research, analyze and move faster, and you pick up new tools quickly.
 Nice To Have 
SQL or BI tool experience
Experience in retail, finance, or consulting
Exposure to underwriting concepts like frequency, severity and loss ratio

 Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. 
 Life at Extend: 
 Working with a great team from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative and supportive environment. 
 Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits. 
 Stock in an early-stage startup growing quickly.

Mighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events. Proven experience in Customer Success, with a track record of delivering exceptional results for clients.
Strong organizational and relationship-building skills, with the ability to manage complex client relationships and navigate challenging conversations effectively.
Experience managing high-value accounts, demonstrating the ability to help successful brands, entrepreneurs, and creators build incredible businesses through the power of community.
A proactive and dynamic approach, thriving in a fast-paced, rapidly growing environment, and constantly seeking ways to enhance impact and value creation.
Curiosity and active listening skills, with a passion for community-powered businesses and a desire to be part of building a new and critical team at a pioneering startup.

An entrepreneurial mindset — you understand what it takes to build something from nothing, which gives you a natural empathy for the creators, entrepreneurs, and brands you'll serve.
A genuine curiosity about AI-driven solutions, consistently exploring how emerging tools can enhance customer outcomes, streamline your own workflows, and unlock new ways for community-powered businesses to grow and thrive.

The chance to shape the future of how communities, creators, and brands thrive online—with the team that’s building what’s next.
Join us in shaping the future of community-driven digital businesses with Mighty Pro!

 Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
 Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
 Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Which is why we’ve built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale. 
 We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We’re expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 
 With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can’t do it exceptionally well, we don’t do it. It’s how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it’s how we’re reinventing what’s possible every day. 
 The Opportunity 
 Plume is looking for a Technical Program Manager to join our Customer Experience organization, reporting directly to the VP of Customer Experience. This role sits at the intersection of technical delivery, program management, and customer success, acting as the connective tissue between our Product and engineering teams, and the Customer Success organization that supports our operator partners.  A natural bridge-builder who can guide a team through change and bring people along during transitions, not just announce them.

Senior Product Marketing Manager, Sales Enablement (AI & Research): 
 Team: Marketing 
 Prolific 
 Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision. 
 The role 
T his is a brand new role, and you’ll be the first person to do it at Prolific. 
 Right now, the insight that could help us win more deals is scattered. We have valuable learnings about why we win, why we lose, and why deals stall, but they aren’t turned into the pitch, proof and materials that sellers use every day. You’ll fix that. You’ll become the person who knows our market position inside out and turns it into tools that help sellers win. 
 This is a revenue role. It sits at the point where product marketing meets sales enablement, across both our AI and research businesses. You’ll dig into win-loss, competitive intelligence and customer proof, then turn it into pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, case studies and training that reps use on their next call. You’ll also help new AEs and SDRs get up to speed faster. 
 You’ll be measured on win rate, sales cycle length, rep ramp time and how well equipped our sellers are in front of a buyer. 
 Our AI PMM leads strategic lab and enterprise AI pursuits, and our vertical PMMs tailor messaging for specific audiences. You own the foundation they all build on: the shared, trusted system of resources every other deal runs on. 
 What you’ll bring to the role 
 6+ years in an enablement-facing role (product marketing, sales enablement or competitive intelligence) at a B2B company 
 Experience enabling sellers across more than one product or product line, at a startup, scale-up or enterprise 
 Experience doing the full job, not just the final slides: you’ve gathered the data and insight yourself, then turned it into materials sellers use 
 Enablement you’ve built that measurably moved win rate, ramp time or deal velocity. You can show who used it and what changed 
 Hands-on experience running buyer interviews. You ask about past behaviour, not hypothetical opinions, and you can get a lost buyer to tell you the real reason 
 Comfort with data: you can pull from a CRM and call-intelligence tools, build an analysis or business case, and defend your conclusions 
 Clear writing for busy readers: short, specific and easy to act on 
 Credibility with sellers and senior leaders, and the ability to get sales, product and customer success to act without managing any of them. You’ll spend a lot of time with sales 
 What you’ll be doing in the role 
 Build and own sales enablement across AI and research: onboarding, ongoing training and launch readiness (with the AI PMM), plus a single source of truth that reps actually use 
 Audit what exists today, decide what stays and what goes, and set up a way to keep it current 
 Build and maintain the core sales toolkit: pitch narrative, decks, one-pagers, discovery guides, battlecards, objection handling, white papers and business-case tools 
 Design and run our win-loss programme: buyer interviews after closed-won, closed-lost and no-decision outcomes, combined with CRM and call data and a regular readout to leadership. You’ll also run one outreach calendar for every AI buyer interview, including the AI PMM’s, so no buyer is asked twice 
 Own competitive intelligence against data labelling vendors, research panel providers and in-house alternatives, including a live view of competitor pricing and positioning that feeds the AI PMM’s category point of view 
 Turn findings into specific changes, such as a new talk track, a revised discovery question or a pricing recommendation, then check whether the change moved the number 
 Own customer proof: case studies with AI and research customers, a sourced library of proof points, the reference programme for live deals, and advocacy through quo
[...]
AI segment win rates the AI PMM is measured on. Work with RevOps to clean up CRM fields for loss reasons and competitor. 
 Why Prolific is a great place to work 
 We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. 
 We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Suki is a leading technology company that provides AI voice solutions for healthcare. Its mission is to reimagine the healthcare technology stack, making it invisible and assistive to lift the administrative burden from clinicians. Its flagship product is Suki Assistant, an AI assistant that uses generative AI to automatically create clinical documentation by ambiently listening to patient-clinician conversations. Suki helps clinicians complete notes 72% faster on average, assists with other tasks including coding and answering questions, and generates incremental revenue for organizations, delivering a 9X ROI in year 1. Suki also offers its proprietary AI and speech platform, Suki Platform, to partners who want to create best-in-class ambient and voice experiences for their solutions. Clinicians that use Suki already spend over 70% less time on administrative tasks, and we’re striving to do even better. Come and join us!
We are a user-driven company and are committed to making sure every pixel of our product is in service of the doctors. As Enterprise Customer Success Manager, your primary role is to drive the successful implementation, deployment and adoption of Suki with our major health system clients. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with key client stakeholders, and ensuring that Suki is delivering exceptionally well on key success metrics. Throughout the client relationship, you will present periodic performance reviews and engage with our clients on opportunities to expand usage and value in partnership. You are able to analyze customer metrics, craft high-impact client presentations, and drive rapid progress against our goals.
As part of our growing Customer Success team, you will also be responsible for improving existing processes and developing new approaches to create high levels of client and user satisfaction. You will also engage with Marketing on opportunities to increase user engagement and provide structured customer insights to our Product team to inform future innovation. You are excited to join the fast-moving Suki team, and committed to excellence!
 Responsibilities and expectations include but are not limited to: 
 Executive-Level Presence and Communications: Ability to communicate both internally and externally with professionalism in person, on video, on the phone, and over email with C-level executives, providers and colleagues.
 Revenue Ownership: We believe in a true ownership model. You will be focused on expanding revenue within our existing customer base, overseeing competitive renewals, upsells and cross-sells, and driving commercial strategy in collaboration.  Adaptability: You thrive in a fast-moving organization that uses light-weight processes and cutting-edge technology to have a huge impact.
 High-Accountability: You can be counted on to consistently deliver high-quality work.
 User-focused: You are obsessed with the customer experience. You can translate key consumer needs into business and product requirements. You have an innate understanding of user behavior, and ensure users are receiving 100% quality service.

or a Technology Innovation Leadership award, just to name a few.
 Great team: Founded, managed, and backed by successful tech veterans from Google and Apple and medical leaders from UCSF and Stanford. We have technologists and doctors working side-by-side to solve complex problems.
 Great investors: We’re backed by Venrock, First Round Capital, Flare Capital, March Capital, Hedosophia and others. With our $165M raised so far, we have the resources to scale.

Description
The Main Mission
You’ll be the primary point of contact for assigned partner institutions, leading onboarding, integrations, and training efforts while building long-term relationships that drive adoption, expansion, and retention. Your goal is not only to support teams but to energize them to achieve more than they thought possible with BoodleBox.
‍
What You'll Do
 Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, trusted partnerships with institutional leaders, faculty, and staff.

 Value Realization: Help teams consistently achieve their goals with BoodleBox by aligning platform features to institutional priorities.

 Product Adoption: Promote best practices and new feature use to increase satisfaction, engagement, and impact.

‍
Required Experience
5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar SaaS-facing role.
Background in higher education or working with institutional teams strongly preferred.
Proven success in building long-term client partnerships that result in renewals and expansions.
Comfortable managing onboarding processes including kickoff calls, SSO/LMS integrations, and training delivery.
Comfortable analyzing adoption data and customer metrics to guide engagement and decisions.
Strong communicator who can influence administrators, faculty, and staff at all levels.
A keen interest in AI’s application in education and a passion to learn, experiment, and apply generative AI in your own work.
‍
What We're Looking For
A relationship-driven professional who can build trust with higher education leaders and teams.
A proactive problem solver who anticipates customer needs and delivers solutions before issues arise.
A confident leader to facilitate strategic conversations with administrators and energize faculty/staff.
A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, remote environment and balances multiple priorities with ease.
A curious learner who is excited about generative AI and passionate about transforming education.
‍
Who We Are
BoodleBox is a team of curious, collaborative builders. We are committed to creating meaningful experiences for our customers and each other. Our culture values:
A desire to learn and grow
A willingness to question and innovate
A focus on building strong relationships and community
A drive to deliver impact in higher education
‍
Why Join BoodleBox?
 Mission That Matters: Help reshape how higher education adopts generative AI by empowering faculty, staff, and students to collaborate responsibly.
 High-Growth Opportunity: Join a VC-backed company scaling quickly with room to grow your career as we expand.
 Remote-First Culture: Work from anywhere while staying connected through a collaborative, supportive, and highly engaged team.
 Innovative Environment: Collaborate with all areas of the business to bring bold ideas to life and directly impact thousands of learners.
 Tight-Knit Team: Be part of a group that values curiosity, trust, and collaboration, where everyone contributes beyond their role to drive success.
‍
What We Offer
A competitive compensation package including a base salary and bonus structure.
Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage (company pays 75% of premiums), as well as a 401(k).
Opportunities for career growth and professional development in a fast-growing company.
A collaborative and supportive remote work environment where your contributions directly impact the future of education.
About the Company
BoodleBox is a VC-backed GenAI platform built for higher education. With 100,000+ users across 1,200+ colleges and universities, we partner with faculty, staff, and students to make responsible AI adoption practical, impactful, and lasting. Our platform brings together leading AI tools — including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity — under one roof, purpose-built for the unique demands of academic environments. We're guided by three core values: service, education, and collaboration.

We are looking for someone with an ingrained passion for people, and a love for finding creative solutions to help others c reate a culture of appreciation within their organization.

 Renewals 
 Working alongside sales to manage the end-to-end customer renewals process 
 Proactively tracking customer renewals (planning & reporting) 
 Create renewals packs for customers (identify upsell opportunities) 
 Engage with vendors for the best commercial offer 
 Contract analysis & pricing validation 
 Process renewals directly or provide the AM with the details 
 Supporting renewals campaigns 
 Knowledge of renewals across all products (including Mitel and Avaya) 
 Following up on cease requests, contacting customers to take every action to prevent customer churn

 Finalising supplier pricing 
 Producing and checking/managing customer opportunities/deals in hubspot 
 Creating & sharing commercial proposals with customers 
 Completing customer order forms 
 Sharing customer contracts and managing contract queries 
 Using Clevr360 to create sales review packs for customers, at sales request 
 Commercial Operations 
 CRM governance/reporting – owning the data related to renewals & sales support 
 Sales forecast support 
 Provide commercial insights from customer interactions 
 Campaign administration

 Commercial negotiations with customers 
 Technical pre-sales 
 Project delivery

 Increased selling time for Account Managers, through reduced administrative burden.

 Greater commercial consistency across renewals and sales support.

 Position Summary 
 The Director of Sales Enablement builds and delivers a practical program that helps e.Republic’s sellers become productive faster, sell consultatively, and confidently connect client needs to the full portfolio. This hands-on leader owns seller onboarding, ongoing sales skills development, product fluency, playbooks, and proficiency assessment.  Onboarding and Seller Readiness 
 Build a structured 30/60/90-day onboarding program with role-specific learning, practice, field application, and clear readiness milestones.

 Sales Skills and Portfolio Fluency 
 Teach discovery, value-based selling, stakeholder mapping, prospecting, objection handling, negotiation, cross-selling, and account development. 
 Build practical learning across events, media, marketing services, Navigator, Industry Insider, and emerging offerings, using approved product positioning. 
 Deliver workshops, call reviews where authorized, deal practice, and focused coaching. Equip pod leaders and the Growth leader to reinforce skills in daily work. 
 Playbooks and Continuous Improvement

 Maintain relevant talk tracks, discovery guides, case examples, competitive guidance, and launch-readiness programs. 
 Use field observation and performance data to prioritize skill gaps; measure application and outcomes with Sales Operations rather than training attendance alone. 
 Use appropriate AI tools for practice, learning support, and content maintenance while protecting client and company information. 
 Sales Collateral and Marketing Partnership 
 Manage one-sheets and other sales collateral, coordinating development, updates, organization, and seller access with Marketing and product owners to keep materials current, accurate, and aligned with approved messaging. 
 Work closely with Marketing on marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) and pipeline conversion, aligning lead handoffs, seller follow-up, and enablement resources to help convert qualified leads into sales opportunities and customers. 
 Qualifications 
 7+ years in B2B sales, sales enablement, or related commercial development, including 3+ years designing and leading enablement programs. 
 Demonstrated success improving seller readiness and performance through onboarding, coaching, and skills assessment. 
 Direct consultative selling experience or substantial experience coaching sellers through complex sales cycles. 
 Strong facilitation and instructional design skills; able to make learning practical for experienced sellers and new hires. 
 Experience supporting multiple products and working with Sales, Marketing, product experts, and Operations.

 Time to demonstrated readiness and productivity for new sellers. 
 Improved proficiency in discovery, value articulation, account planning, and cross-portfolio selling. 
 Manager reinforcement and seller application of playbooks and learned skills. 
 Changes in relevant conversion, win-rate, deal-quality, and portfolio-penetration measures, interpreted with Sales Operations. 
 Current, accurate resources and effective readiness support for product launches. 
 Working Relationships and Accountability 
 Recommended placement is under the CRO, with quarterly priorities agreed with the CGO and regular access to managers and sellers. The Director owns the enablement program and assessment standards; sales managers own daily coaching, performance reviews, and accountability. Marketing owns brand and core positioning; product and Event Revenue owners validate offer details. Sales Operations owns data, workflow support, and systems training. The Director coordinates these contributions and does not carry a sales book.

You're the person people turn to when things get complex, whether technical, customer-facing, operational or cross-functional.

Work with Senior and Principal engineers across regions to resolve recurring support workflow challenges.
Guide triage practices so issues are isolated quickly and accurately across the team.

Set a high standard for technical quality, communication, accountability and customer ownership.
Flag capability gaps to Customer Success leadership and help close them through training, documentation and hiring input.
Support engineers through complex cases while building their confidence to lead them independently.
Foster a culture of learning, knowledge sharing, collaboration and constructive feedback.
 Proactive customer engagement 
Build trusted relationships with key Enterprise customers through regular account syncs, acting as their senior technical partner.
Lead onboardings and regular syncs for Enterprise customers, whose complex environments need senior-level judgement. Onboardings are complet

 our people are given freedom to decide when they are most productive. Everyone is unique after all.
Employee share scheme

Company retreats

About Strategus 
 Strategus is an advertising technology company that helps brands and agencies drive measurable business outcomes through data-driven strategy, cross-channel media, and transparent reporting across every screen. From CTV and online video to display, streaming audio, and digital out-of-home, Strategus aligns every channel around the business results that matter most.
 Our culture is grounded in three values: Respect, Full Engagement, and Growth. They shape how we work, make decisions, and show up for clients and one another. Our north star is simple: make Strategus the best job you’ve ever had. That means building a high-performing team where people are trusted to contribute, supported in their development, and empowered to shape what comes next. Together, we’re helping define the future of CTV and programmatic advertising while delivering smarter outcomes for the clients who count on us. 
 About the role 
 Strategus is building a modern, insight-led sales organization for 2027, and we're looking for a Sales Enablement & Revenue Operations Lead to help get us there. Reporting to the EVP of Sales, you'll own new-seller onboarding, ongoing sales training, the sales playbook, and adoption of the tools our sellers use every day, including Salesforce, Gong, sales-intent and prospecting tools, and approved AI tools. 
 This is a hands-on role focused on how sellers work, not on forecasting, spreadsheet-heavy reporting, or sales-planning models. You'll measure whether training and tools are changing seller behavior, and partner with managers to close the gaps. 
 What you'll be doing as a Sales Enablement & Revenue Operations Lead: 
 Own the sales enablement strategy, program calendar, and day-to-day execution, aligned with Sales leadership's priorities 
 Build role-based learning paths covering Strategus positioning, products, sales methodology, core selling skills, sales processes, and tools 
 Run new-seller onboarding from day one through full productivity, with clear ramp milestones, practice assignments, and certifications 
 Partner with frontline managers to assess readiness through role-plays, account work, live opportunities, and Gong call reviews, and build targeted 30-day plans when a seller misses a milestone 
 Deliver ongoing training for new and experienced sellers on prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposals, objection handling, negotiation, closing, and client handoffs 
 Reinforce Challenger, MEDDIC, and other methods adopted by Sales leadership through real examples and live opportunities 
 Partner with Marketing, Product, and Planning to turn product launches, market insights, and approved messaging into seller-ready training 
 Equip frontline managers with coaching guides, practice exercises, and reinforcement plans so learning continues in team meetings, one-on-ones, and deal coaching 
 Drive adoption of Salesforce, sales-intent and prospecting tools, Gong, and approved AI tools, and teach sellers the practical workflow for each 
 Turn approved AI capabilities into everyday seller workflows for research, meeting prep, and drafting, with clear guidance on responsible use and protecting client information 
 Own the sales playbook and keep onboarding materials, job aids, recordings, and call examples current and easy to find 
 Track onboarding progress, certifications, proficiency, and tool adoption, and re-measure after each program to confirm seller behavior improved 
 Partner with platform owners on requirements, testing, and rollout of system improvements 
 Share regular, action-oriented updates with Sales leadership on progress, gaps, and recommended next steps 
 Qualifications: 
 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales training, revenue or sales operations, or a related commercial role 
 Proven track record of building and running onboarding and ongoing training programs that improve ramp and seller performance 
 Hands-on experience driving CRM adoption, preferably Salesforce, through practical training, workflow design, and manager reinforcement 
 Experience with Gong or a similar conversation-intelligence platform for coaching and skill development 
 Familiarity with sales-intent and prospecting tools and how sellers use them to prioritize accounts and personalize outreach 
 Experience teaching sales methodologies such as Challenger or MEDDIC 
 Ability to create clear learning paths, role-plays, job aids, certifications, and playbooks 
 Comfortable using adoption data, performance signals, and field feedback to find gaps and show what's working 
 Practical experience with AI-enabled sales workflows and sound judgment about protecting client and company information 
 Excellent facilitation, coaching, writing, and project-management skills, with credibility among sellers, managers, and sales leaders 
 A hands-on, change-oriented approach focused on helping people apply new skills, not just delivering training 
 Experience in digital advertising, ad tech, or media sales preferred 
 Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field preferred 
 We offer a base salary of $100,000-$120,000, but that's just the starting point. This role includes a profit share bonus of up to 15%, plus a full benefits package, because we believe in rewarding the people who help us grow.
 Strategus is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to diversity and inclusion, as well as non-discrimination in employment. All qualified applicants receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, veteran status, disability unrelated to performing the essential task of the job or other legally protected categories. * Design and implement lead scoring, routing and lifecycle stage definitions in Marketo and Salesforce in partnership with Sales and Marketing.
* Maintain and enforce SLA compliance across MQL, SAL and SQL handoffs.
* Identify bottlenecks and conversion gaps across the funnel and propose data-driven solutions.
* Provide guidance to team members on funnel management best practices and support execution consistency.

* Act as the Marketo power user and platform owner: manage programs, channels, templates, smart lists, tokens and scoring, and keep the Marketo-Salesforce sync reliable.
* Sync CaPDB account, competitor, product and renewal fields from Salesforce into Marketo so we can segment audiences and trigger campaigns by competitor, product gap and contract end date.

members when needed.

Frontify is the brand platform behind some of the world's leading organizations, including Microsoft, Telefónica, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, and Kia. We help every team bring brands to life — with governance in one place, seamless workflows across the tools people already use, and a foundation that's ready for AI.
We're driven by collaboration, curiosity, and the belief that great work can happen anywhere. What began in St. Gallen has grown to London, New York, and beyond. Wherever you join us, you'll take ownership from day one, shape work that reaches global brands, and help redefine how brands work in the age of AI.

Working closely with our Principal Revenue Enablement, you'll combine hands-on enablement with commercial content creation. From developing playbooks to creating compelling materials, you'll help teams build the knowledge and resources they need to succeed.
You'll turn insights from customer conversations into practical improvements, using AI-powered tools and self-service resources to help teams work more independently.

Reporting to our Principal Revenue Enablement and working closely with our commercial teams to identify challenges and deliver practical enablement initiatives across the US and EMEA.

Create compelling commercial materials, including sales decks, business cases, battlecards, and customer-facing resources that help teams communicate Frontify's value.
Maintain and improve our master commercial deck and content library, keeping materials accurate, consistent, and easy to access.
Help teams use AI-powered content creation tools and reusable templates to create high-quality materials more independently.
Collaborate with Product Marketing and Creative Studio to ensure commercial resources reflect Frontify's positioning, messaging, and brand.
Work in a hybrid setup, spending two days per week in our London office.
 What You Bring
3+ years of experience in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or creating commercial content within a sales enablement environment, ideally in B2B SaaS.
A solid understanding of the B2B sales cycle and how enablement helps teams improve their effectiveness and progress opportunities.
Experience contributing to sales enablement activities, from creating playbooks to supporting sales processes and best practices.
Strong commercial writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex ideas and customer challenges into clear, persuasive materials.
Experience collaborating with Sales, Customer Success, or other commercial teams to understand challenges and develop practical solutions.
A curious, analytical mindset, with the ability to turn customer conversations and commercial insights into actionable improvements.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage priorities, collaborate with stakeholders, and deliver quality work.
Confidence using presentation tools such as Pitch, PowerPoint, or Google Slides, alongside an interest in AI-powered content creation.
Familiarity with Gong, Clozd, MEDDIC, or similar enablement tools and sales methodologies is a plus.

A minimum of 25 days of annual leave per year
Paid educational and wellbeing days off
Wellbeing, learning and development, and commuter allowance
Home office setup budget
Weekly free office lunch

Localized benefits
Invite to our summer company meet-up

Dropbox is a Virtual First company. For this role, we are currently only authorized to hire candidates from the following provinces: Alberta, British Columbia, Ontario, and Saskatchewan.
Role Description
As a GTM Program Manager focused on the GTM organization, you will turn revenue-driving strategies into operational execution. You will play a crucial role in translating business priorities into the systems, processes, and business rules needed to bring new commercial initiatives to life and scale existing motions.
You will lead cross-functional planning, define business requirements, align stakeholders, and drive delivery with business and technical partners. Your work will connect teams across the customer lifecycle, ensure operational readiness, and measure whether implemented solutions achieve their intended business outcomes.
You will play a crucial part in helping the organization deliver on its growth strategy. You’ll build partnerships across GTM functions and see the direct impact of your work on revenue execution and the customer and seller experience.
 Responsibilities
Translate strategy into execution: Turn revenue-driving strategies into actionable plans across GTM systems, processes, and business rules.
Define business requirements: Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, document requirements, and establish clear success criteria.
Lead cross-functional delivery: Manage programs from discovery through implementation, coordinating scope, timelines, dependencies, and accountable owners.
Drive solution development: Partner with business and technical teams to evaluate options, resolve gaps, and implement scalable solutions.
Align stakeholders and decisions: Facilitate discussions, clarify tradeoffs, and drive agreement on priorities, ownership, and outstanding decisions.
Ensure operational readiness: Coordinate testing, documentation, and change management to support successful launches and adoption.
Measure outcomes and improve: Track results against business objectives, identify operational gaps, and drive improvements to execution and the customer and seller experience.
 Requirements
At least 3 years of overall professional experience.
3+ years of experience in Product Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Business Systems, or another role supporting complex cross-functional GTM initiatives.
Experience working in a B2B SaaS or subscription-based business with multiple products, customer segments, or routes to market.
Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, process workflows, and measurable success criteria.
Experience partnering with technical and business teams to evaluate solutions, assess tradeoffs, and validate that changes meet business needs.
Ability to identify root causes, use data to assess outcomes, and implement practical improvements that scale.
Strong systems thinking, with the ability to understand how a change in one part of the commercial lifecycle can affect downstream processes, systems, data, and customer experiences.
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Salesforce, CPQ, billing, commerce, provisioning, entitlement, or other systems supporting the quote-to-cash/customer lifecycle.
Understanding of the customer lifecycle and how systems, processes, data, and business rules support commercial execution.
Familiarity with automation and AI capabilities that can simplify requirements gathering, dependency management, testing, and operational readiness.
Durable Skills
 Skills
 AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:
Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

 Compensation

li-4487834628.description:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.
Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.
As our Compensation Manager, you will own how Profound pays and motivates its go-to-market team. Sitting within GTM Operations, you will partner with Sales and Post-Sales leadership to design incentive plans that drive the right behavior, and you will run the comp engine behind them: calculations, systems, and payouts. You will work very closely with our Payroll team so every rep is paid accurately and on time, and with Finance so plans are modeled, budgeted, and accounted for correctly. This is a 0-to-1 role: you will build the comp function's systems, processes, and controls as our GTM team scales.
 What You’ll Do
 Incentive design
Own incentive plan design across GTM roles, including Account Executives, SDRs, Account Managers, Engagement Managers, and other Post-Sales and Sales roles
Partner with Sales and Post-Sales leadership to translate GTM strategy (new logo, expansion, retention) into plan mechanics: pay mix, rates, accelerators, ramps, and SPIFs
Partner with GTM Ops on quota setting, capacity, and territory alignment so targets, coverage, and plans fit together each planning cycle
Partner with Finance to model plan cost, attainment scenarios, and earnings distribution, and to keep comp within budget
 Comp operations and payouts
Run the commissions cycle end to end: crediting, calculations, review, approvals, and payout
Partner very closely with Payroll on payout files, timing, and reconciliation so commissions and SPIFs are paid accurately and on schedule
Own plan documents, participant acknowledgments, and the comp calendar
Communicate plans and changes to the field clearly and simply, and be the go-to resource for comp questions
Run a consistent process for inquiries, disputes, and exceptions, and flag recurring exceptions as plan-design issues rather than one-off fixes
 Systems, reporting, and compliance
Build and own our comp systems, including selecting, implementing, and administering a commission platform integrated with Salesforce, HRIS, and payroll
Partner with Revenue Systems and GTM Engineering to keep bookings, roster, and crediting data clean and in sync across systems
Build reporting and dashboards on attainment, payout cost, and plan effectiveness for reps, leaders, and Finance
Partner with Accounting on monthly commission accruals, with documentation and controls that hold up to audit
Use AI and automation to remove manual work, such as data validation, discrepancy checks, and payout estimates for reps
 Who you are
3 to 5+ years of experience in sales compensation, GTM or revenue operations, or FP&A, with hands-on ownership of both plan design and comp operations
Deep understanding of incentive mechanics, including quotas, accelerators, ramps, draws, clawbacks, and SPIFs, across both new business and post-sales roles
Strong Salesforce knowledge, especially how opportunity and booking data flows into commission calculations
Track record partnering with Payroll and Finance to deliver accurate, on-time payouts and clean month-end close
Highly analytical, with advanced Excel or Sheets modeling skills; SQL experience is a plus, not required
A natural business partner who builds trust quickly with sales leaders and reps and can explain comp mechanics simply
Exceptional attention to detail and sound judgment handling confidential pay data
Thrives in ambiguity with a 0-to-1 mindset, and is energized by building structure, processes, and tools where none exist yet
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI assistants or automation tools to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy
 Nice to have
Experience standing up a comp function or commission platform at a fast-growing, early-stage SaaS or AI company
Experience with HRIS and payroll integrations, and with multi-country or international comp plans
 Location
 NYC preferred; remote or other locations (SF, Boston, London) considered. This role is for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.
For this role, the expected base salary range is $200,000 to $220,000 (US) and £100,000 to £140,000 (UK). Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.
Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.
 Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.
 About The Sales Operations Team
 The Sales Operations team helps Thumbtack’s sales and account management teams grow revenue. We build the programs and tools that help reps bring local service businesses onto Thumbtack and grow strategic existing accounts. The work spans acquisition and account management, with close partners in Product, Marketing, Data Science, Enablement, and QA.
 About The Role
 You’ll drive Thumbtack’s sales strategy and partner closely with the Sales leadership team to execute it. Your focus is growing sales revenue by bringing more pros onto Thumbtack and expanding relationships with existing accounts.
Reporting to the Vice President of Commercial Operations, you’ll lead analysts and managers across North America and the Philippines. There’s room to build new approaches to outbound prospecting, account expansion, and the use of AI in sales. You’ll get close to the data and frontline work yourself, then turn what you learn into programs and strategic levers that’ll deliver impact.
 What You’ll Do
Drive the sales strategy to grow revenue, partnering closely with Sales leadership to set priorities and execute against shared goals.
Build new approaches to outbound acquisition and existing account expansion. Test them in the field and scale what works.
Get into the data and spend time with reps and pros to understand where there’s opportunities to maximize sales and pro lifetime value. Turn those findings into changes that improve conversion and account growth.
Use AI to build better prospecting, selling, and account management workflows. Measure whether reps use them and whether they increase revenue or productivity.
Get agreement on priorities and ownership with Product, Marketing, Data Science, and sales technology partners. Resolve dependencies that hold up execution.
Keep core sales operations running well, including lead routing, account management workflows, and sales tools, so reps can spend more time selling.
Develop the managers on your team and give them clear ownership. Make hiring and performance decisions that build the team’s ability to deliver.
 In order to be successful, you must bring
Experience developing and executing sales or commercial strategy, with clear evidence of revenue growth. High-volume sales to small businesses is especially relevant; management consulting experience is a plus.
The analytical depth to investigate a problem yourself. You question metric definitions, check the underlying data, and test whether your diagnosis holds up.
Experience building a new sales motion, team, or operating capability from an unclear starting point. You’ve done the work to get it adopted and can show what impact that created.
Experience leading managers and developing people. You set clear expectations, give direct feedback, and make difficult decisions when the team needs them.
Clear communication and sound judgment with partners. You can challenge a senior stakeholder’s assumptions with data and evidence, understand your partner’s differing view and drive impact with speed.
Curiosity and urgency. You learn unfamiliar areas quickly and are willing to try a different approach. You can make a call with imperfect information and adjust as you learn.
 Expected salary ranges
For candidates living in Ontario and British Columbia, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for this role is currently $183,600 - $237,600

The Opportunity
Euna Solutions is hiring a Go-to-Market Intelligence Analyst to own the account and contact intelligence layer that tells our sellers which public sector agencies to pursue and when. You will build and refine the scoring models, data standards, segmentation logic, and competitive intelligence that drive how Euna targets and wins in the government market. If you want your analytical work to shape real commercial decisions rather than land in a deck, this is the role for you.
What You'll Do
Own Intent-to-Buy and Propensity-to-Buy scoring models across solutions and segments, including inputs, logic, validation against closed outcomes, and ongoing recalibration
Bring public sector signal sources, including procurement activity, grant awards, and audit and compliance data, into the scoring models and test whether each one predicts conversion
Define and enforce account and contact data standards for prospect and target accounts, driving remediation with GTM Systems rather than stopping at the report
Analyze win rate, sales cycle, churn, and expansion patterns by segment and vertical to sharpen the ICP and translate findings into targeting rules the field can execute
Own competitive intelligence across segments and solutions, including win/loss patterns and FOIA-sourced commercial insight
Partner with Sales, BD, and Marketing to operationalize scoring and segmentation into territory views, prioritized target lists, and outbound workflows
What You Bring
You have 4+ years in go-to-market analytics, revenue operations, market intelligence, or a comparable analytical function
You have built, maintained, or evaluated an account or propensity scoring model and can speak to how it was validated and what you changed based on evidence
You bring strong Salesforce capability, including reporting and a working understanding of the account, contact, and opportunity data model
You are fluent in advanced Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable working with large, messy, multi-source datasets
You can explain a model's logic, its limits, and its results clearly to non-technical sellers and leaders
 Nice-to-Have Qualifications
Familiarity with public sector procurement cycles, budget data, or the GovTech market
Experience managing enrichment or intent data vendor relationships, including ingestion logic and refresh cadence
Hands-on experience with SQL and one or more BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
Practical use of AI tooling for research, enrichment, or unstructured data analysis
Location
This position will be hybrid with 3 days/week in our[Oakville, ON office.
Compensation Range: $88,000-$110,000
We believe in openness, so we publish our range from the start. Where an offer will land depends on your background, strengths, and how you'll contribute to the work ahead.

We're looking for people who are curious about emerging technologies, eager to experiment, and committed to using AI responsibly to augment, not replace, their expertise.
If you enjoy exploring new ways to solve problems, learning continuously, and applying AI to make your work smarter and more impactful, you'll thrive here.

Role Overview
 The Sales Compensation Business Partner, MXRM is the dedicated compensation partner for approximately 500 MXRM GTM professionals globally, spanning Specialized Sales, Pre-Sales / PDEs, Services sellers, sales management, and partner/channel roles. The role brings focused ownership to work currently split between the Head of MXRM GRO and in-zone GTM Operations teams without dedicated compensation expertise.
The role is the single point of accountability inside MXRM across the compensation year—from quota setting through plan rollout, seller questions, mid-year changes, reporting and year-end payout queries. It connects field needs with the central DISW compensation function, resolving what can be handled locally and escalating clear, well-framed cases when needed.
This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. Influence comes from compensation expertise, sound judgment and credibility with sellers, country managers and the central compensation team. The position is designed as a full-year role: October–January quota setting is the peak cycle, supported by year-round governance, analytics, enablement and plan-effectiveness work.
 Key Responsibilities
 Quota Setting Process (October–January)
Own the end-to-end MXRM quota-setting process for Pre-Sales / PDEs, Services sellers, Specialized Sales and sales management. Partner with Country Managers, who set individual seller quotas, to validate country-level coverage against targets, reconcile aggregates, issue PCTs on time and ensure sellers have signed plans before the fiscal year opens. This is the role’s highest-value and highest-visibility annual deliverable.
 Compensation Plan Rollout & Enablement
Lead the field-facing annual plan rollout: translate approved designs into clear communications, deliver enablement by role and zone, publish supporting materials and help the organization understand plan mechanics before payouts begin. When plans change, explain both what is changing and why.
 Voice of MXRM in Compensation Strategy
Represent MXRM in compensation-design discussions with the central DISW Compensation team, bringing the Specialized Sales perspective upstream rather than after plans are finalized. Make evidence-based cases where corporate defaults do not fit MXRM’s GTM motions, including ARR / NRR priorities, Land-to-Expand and a high-velocity funnel; document MXRM requests and track outcomes.
 First Line of Defence — Seller Compensation Queries
Serve as the single MXRM point of contact for questions about payouts, deal credit and plan-rule application. Resolve issues locally where possible; escalate structured, well-framed cases to the central team when necessary. Provide a dependable support path for sellers while reducing avoidable load on the Head of MXRM GRO, in-zone Operations and central Compensation.
 Governance of Mid-Year Seller Changes
Govern compensation-related handling of role moves, territory splits, transfers, hires and leavers. Ensure account-team membership, LAER crediting setup and SAP Commissions configuration are updated so transactions can be credited correctly. Establish systemic data-hygiene controls and return actionable fixes to field owners; this is not transaction-by-transaction policing.
 Compensation Performance Reporting
Deliver a standing monthly / quarterly compensation view for MXRM leadership, covering payout analytics, attainment distribution, outliers, potential under- or overpayment flags, and FSO consolidation and submission to central compensation administrators. Build a concise management view and respond to material Country Manager requests.
 Compensation Plan Effectiveness Analysis
Evaluate whether plan mechanics and incentives drove intended behavior. Identify gaming patterns and areas where rewards may not align with desired outcomes; provide a credible evidence base for the next fiscal-year plan-design cycle and the role’s MXRM advocacy.
 SPIF / Incentive Program Design & Tracking
Design, track and close out MXRM-focused SPIFs, accelerators and contests tied to specific commercial objectives. Partner with central Compensation on structure and compliance; own MXRM execution, commun
[...]
uding attainment, coverage, pipeline-versus-quota and account-team / LAER data-hygiene checks.
Working fluency in sales-plan mechanics, including quota crediting, splits, accelerators, draws, clawbacks, SPIFs and FSO handling.
Sound judgment and the ability to say “no” with empathy: listen to seller concerns, explain decisions clearly and remain firm without becoming confrontational.
Strong written communication, including the ability to explain a complex plan rule in clear, practical language.
Comfort working across a matrix of field leadership, Country Managers, central Compensation and Finance.
Fluent English.
 Nice to Have
Finance background, including the ability to read a budget, reconcile coverage math and understand the P&L implications of compensation decisions.
Exposure to SAP Commissions or an equivalent sales performance management platform such as Varicent, Xactly or CaptivateIQ.
Experience in a large, matrixed corporate organization and familiarity with central-team operating models.
Prior involvement in compensation-plan design, not only administration or execution.

Head of GTM (London) 
 Our Client 
A Proptech platform allowing companies to rent properties with more ease and for less cost. They launched in April 2026, and have already hit £6m in revenue, now they need to scale from £5m - £100m. They've raised £4m seed and signed 60,000+ units with some of the UK's biggest build-to-rent operators. Next year's target is to triple revenue. They want to hire someone exceptional who has delivered incredible results in their career to date, this is a chance to challenge and dominate a big sector with a few legacy players.
 What You'll Get 
Competitive base up to £150k, uncapped commission and equity. You'll be the first GTM hire, reporting to the Founder & CEO, with a clear path to building and leading the commercial team and a route to the C-suite. The role is in central London four days a week, with Fridays at home.
 What You'll Do 
So far the founder has won every deal. Your job is to change that. You'll build the playbook, set up the CRM and metrics, and take the business beyond build-to-rent into estate agencies managing 100 to 3,000 properties, then relocation firms, employers and overseas partners. You'll also close deals yourself. The sales cycle is short, so pace matters. Year one is a success if there's a repeatable sales process and at least one channel winning deals without the founder involved.
 What You'll Need 
You've built a sales process from scratch at an early-stage company and closed complex B2B deals. You're self-driven, low-ego and honest enough to share bad news early. A Tech background is a must, but how you build pipeline matters more than who you know. It's a team of around ten and the pace is intense, so you'll need to want that.

 About Zen Educate
 Zen Educate is a technology company that matches schools with temporary educator staff. Our mission is to change the world of education recruitment. Schools spend over $9bn a year on temporary educators, with over $2bn per year of that spent on fees that take money out of the education system. By leveraging the latest technology, we purpose built a platform that helps schools to pay less while educators earn more.
We want students to have access to the best education possible, and we go the extra mile to find, onboard, match, and coach incredible educators that deeply care about their students. We wake up every day on a mission to care more. We care more about our schools. And we care more about our educators.
We have recently raised our Series B funding of $37mil, the largest round in European EdTech last year. This is an exciting opportunity to make a difference and be part of a high growth start-up that is expanding rapidly in the UK and US markets!
 Why this role exists
 Zen Educate places educators in K-12 schools across :20 US regions. Behind every new partnership sits operational work that has to be done right: RFP submissions with tight deadlines and long compliance checklists, hectic conference seasons with significant logistical and planning requirements, nuanced district contracting processes that need to be managed with care and attention.
As Zen has grown, so has the volume of this work, and we're investing in RevOps capacity to match. That gives us room to run each process well and to keep raising the bar on it: every RFP, conference and contract is a chance to make the next one faster and more automated while holding the same standard of polish and accuracy.
This role takes ownership of the critical operational tasks RevOps supports today, and is accountable for how each one turns out. You'll learn each process by running it yourself, which is how you'll see where it breaks and which steps can be automated. Then you'll build those automations, so the work gets faster and more reliable each cycle and frees you to take on the next area. RFPs, conferences and deal desk are where you start. As those run well, the role grows into other parts of RevOps where the same approach pays off.
 What You'll Own
 Your first priorities are below. Each one has a direct line to how quickly Zen signs and launches new partnerships, and they're where RevOps support is most stretched today. Expect the list to change as your automations take work off your plate and new areas need an owner.
 RFP submission coordination. You'll own Zen's RFP process from the moment a bid is identified through submission, and early on it will take the largest share of your time. That means understanding what each district is asking for and what it takes to be compliant, building responses from our existing content, and bringing in subject matter experts across sales, operations, compliance and finance where a question needs something new. You set the plan, keep contributors on it, and make sure what goes out is complete and compelling. The quality of what goes out decides whether we win, so each bid should leave our content library and process in better shape for the next one.
 Conference and event coordination . Our sales team attends state and national education conferences throughout the year, and they're some of the best chances reps get to meet district decision makers in person. Once an event is on the calendar, you own setting the team up to make the most of it. That covers logistics (registration, booth and sponsorship, shipping, travel, spend against the events budget) and the work around them: pulling attendee lists, supporting the coordination and planning of tertiary events around the conference, collaborating with marketing sponsorships that put us in front of the right people, and making sure every key progress with conference attendees is logged in Hubspot following the event.

Develop, implement, and optimize the Zone Pricing Strategy and Commercial Policy governance to drive profitable growth and market competitiveness.

Value-based pricing

Cost drivers

Proven ability to lead and collaborate effectively across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Management teams.

li-4489207247.description:
About Wolt
 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
 About The Role
 Wolt is on a growth journey as part of the DoorDash family, together with Deliveroo. Drive is our delivery-as-a-service business: we let merchants offer fast, reliable delivery in their own channels (their webshop, app or ordering system), powered by the Wolt and Deliveroo courier networks. We're now bringing Drive across Wolt and Deliveroo countries together into one EMEA business , with one team and a clear ambition: grow fast and build a business that stands on its own feet.
A growing share of that scaling comes from outside restaurants: grocers, retailers, pharmacies and other eComm players who want on-demand and same-day delivery for their own customers. Their needs can be very different from restaurants: bigger baskets, scheduled and batched deliveries, larger and heavier items, longer distances and more complex integrations. This brings us to you, our next Manager, Strategy & Operations for Grocery & Retail Drive.
You'll own this segment across EMEA, from strategy and planning to pricing, product requirements and performance. You'll work hand in hand with our regional commercial teams, who own the partner relationships, and with Product, Logistics, Finance and our Marketplace grocery & retail teams. You'll join the Drive EMEA Strategy & Operations team and report to the Director of Strategy & Operations, Drive EMEA.
 What You'll Be Doing
Own the Grocery & Retail strategy and annual plan for Drive EMEA: where we play, which partners we go after, and the growth and profitability we commit to.
Set the commercial framework for the segment, including pricing guidelines, deal economics and investment cases for our largest partnerships, together with the regional commercial leads.
Act as the voice of grocery and retail partners towards Product and Logistics, turning commercial needs such as scheduled delivery or large and heavy items into sized, prioritized requirements.
Run performance management for the segment: track growth, unit economics and service levels for our biggest partners, spot what's off and drive the fix with the teams involved.
Shape how Drive works with our Marketplace grocery & retail teams, so partners get one joined-up offer from us.
Turn wins into playbooks that country teams can reuse, from the first pitch to launch and scale-up.
 Our humble expectations
5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, business development, commercial roles or management consulting, with a track record of owning outcomes, not just recommendations.
Strong commercial and analytical skills: you can build a deal P&L or a segment plan from scratch, and defend it in front of a partner's leadership or our own.
Proven ability to get things done across a matrix organization without direct authority, working with regional teams, Product, Logistics and Finance.
You use AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) in your daily work, for example in analysis, planning and ways of working, and look for new ways to apply them to elevate you - whilst maintaining strong judgement that comes from personal understanding complex systems
Structured thinking and clear, concise communication in English, both written and spoken.
Willingness to travel occasionally across our EMEA markets.
 Seen as a strong advantage:
Background in retail, grocery, e-commerce, logistics or on-demand delivery, either in-house or advising companies in these sectors.
Experience with B2B platform or delivery-as-a-service businesses.
 Why you'll love it
🚀 Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving business at the moment it's being built, across two of Europe's best-known delivery brands
🛒 A segment to own: Work with some of the biggest grocery and retail brands in Europe, and see what you write end up on the product roadmap
🤩 Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career with direct access to DoorDash's global Drive experience and room to grow as the segment scales
💪 Instant impact: Take ownership and make a difference
💙 Big hearts and small egos: Surround yourself with smart, friendly people
 Next steps
 If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply, make sure to add your CV in English and get the conversation going! We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
 Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Intelligently Moving Your World 
 XPENG is a leading technology company focused on designing, developing, manufacturing, and marketing intelligent mobility solutions, including electric vehicles (EVs), electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft, and robotics. We aim to create a thoughtful and empathetic future for mobility that enhances driving experience. Headquartered in Guangzhou, China, XPENG has regional offices in Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Silicon Valley, and San Diego, and in 2021, we established our European headquarters in Amsterdam, along with offices in Copenhagen, Munich, Oslo, and Stockholm.
Our passionate and diverse team, with expertise in technology, finance, and the automotive industry, spans hubs in China, the US, and Europe. Together, we are forging our international presence as pioneers in the future of mobility.
 Why should you be part of our success story? 
 XPENG Inc.'s American Depositary Shares (ADSs) have been listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the symbol 'XPEV' since August 27, 2020, and on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (SEHK) under the symbol '9868.HK' since July 7, 2021. In 2023, XPENG further strengthened its growth trajectory with a $724 million strategic investment from Volkswagen, solidifying its position in the global market. There has never been a more exciting time to join XPENG — a leader in smart electric vehicles and sustainable mobility solutions.
 About XPENG and Belgium expansion 
XPENG is a young technology company building smart electric vehicles and shaping the future of AI mobility. We started with a small team and big ideas, and we still keep that explorer mindset today. We move fast, we challenge convention, and we turn ambitious technology into real world customer experience. Because our Belux business is growing strongly, we are expanding our activities and opening a new office in Mechelen, Belgium. If you want a role where you can build, learn, and have visible impact, you will feel at home here.
 Sales Operations Specialist - Belux 
 The role in a nutshell 
You keep fleet sales running smoothly behind the scenes. You make sure orders are clean, systems are correct, and partners get quick answers. You are the link between leasing partners, retail partners, and internal teams, ensuring that the order journey moves without friction from contract to registration to delivery readiness. When the pace increases, you bring structure and calm.
 What you will focus on in the first 90 days 
Learn our fleet order flow end to end including systems, partner touchpoints, and approval steps
Bring order hygiene to a high standard by tightening validation and documentation routines
Build a reliable cadence with leasing partners and stores for questions, exceptions, and status updates
Create a clear view on stock allocation logic and reduce manual rework and delays
 What you will do 
Receive and validate incoming fleet orders and contracts from leasing partners, stores or agents, and internal stakeholders
Check completeness and accuracy of contract terms, vehicle specifications, billing details, and delivery information
Enter orders into internal systems such as Scepter and ensure correct triggers for logistics and delivery workflows
Allocate available stock vehicles to incoming orders in coordination with planning and logistics
Monitor order progress from entry to delivery readiness and proactively resolve issues or delays
Support stores and leasing partners with questions on order processing and tools such as Leaselink, NCO, or similar systems
Coordinate registration and handover documentation with local authorities and registration partners across Belux as applicable
Maintain clear documentation for fleet orders until invoicing and final delivery are complete
Own fleet sales reporting such as pipeline, order intake, and conversion views and keep CRM hygiene standards high
Build templates and simple tools that standardise the process and speed up execution
 What success looks like 
Fleet orders are clean and complete and can move through the process without rework
Partners get fast answers and trust the status because data is accurate
