This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Success Operations Manager based in Canada.
 The Customer Success Operations Manager will build and optimise the processes, systems and data infrastructure that enable a high-performing Customer Success organisation. This role combines operational strategy, analytics and cross-functional leadership to improve customer retention, renewals, expansion and overall team effectiveness. The successful candidate will own the Customer Success technology stack, develop scalable playbooks and introduce automation and AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual work and identify customer risks earlier. By transforming complex data into actionable insights, they will help leadership make informed decisions and strengthen customer relationships. Working closely with Sales, Product, Finance and Support, this individual will establish the operating frameworks needed to support a growing enterprise customer base in a fast-paced B2B environment.
Accountabilities
Own and optimise the Customer Success technology stack, including HubSpot, Gong and Custify, or equivalent platforms, ensuring effective health scoring, workflow automation and data hygiene.
Design, document and maintain standardised playbooks for customer onboarding, adoption, renewals and escalations.
Identify, evaluate and implement AI-enabled workflows that reduce manual Customer Success activities, improve efficiency and surface customer risks earlier.
Facilitate and co-own the renewal forecasting process in partnership with Customer Success leadership.
Develop and maintain KPI frameworks, dashboards and reporting systems covering retention, renewals, expansion and customer health.
Lead recurring business reviews and forecasting activities, translating operational data into clear insights, risks, trends and recommendations for leadership and executives.
Coordinate annual NPS surveys, analyse results and develop action plans to improve customer experience.
Analyse data across multiple systems to identify the factors influencing customer churn and expansion, recommending opportunities for improvement.
Manage customer segmentation and support capacity planning to ensure appropriate coverage across the customer base.
Establish operating cadences, planning processes and capacity models that improve predictability and support the team's growth.
Collaborate with Sales, Product, Finance and Support to align customer handoffs, renewal forecasts and feedback processes.
Lead cross-functional initiatives from initial scoping through implementation, influencing stakeholders without direct authority and measuring outcomes.
Build a consistent customer health and risk model that is trusted and actively used by Customer Success teams and leadership.
Develop self-service reporting and operational visibility that reduce ad hoc requests and help identify risks and bottlenecks early.
 Requirements
At least 5 years of experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy & Operations or a related field.
Hands-on experience with HubSpot and a Customer Success platform such as Custify or a comparable solution.
Proven ability to build and implement operational playbooks, reporting frameworks and operating cadences that teams consistently adopt.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to consolidate complex or fragmented data from multiple systems into meaningful insights and recommendations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings and recommendations to senior leadership.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders without direct management authority.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, creating structure and scalable processes while maintaining execution momentum.
Additional assets: Experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software, implementing AI tools in Customer Success or Revenue Operations, or building a Customer Success Operations function from the ground up and supporting its growth.
 Benefits
Annual compensation range of USD $120,000–$130,000 for the United States-based position. A separate salary range for Canada is not specified.
Remote work arrangement, with Canada listed as an eligible location.

About The Role And Team
 Sales at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don’t come with a script. As a Senior Sales Operations Associate, you will be a key analytical partner to our Go-to-Market leadership, building the models and frameworks that drive our commercial engine. You will sit at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution, translating complex business questions into practical sales strategies that improve productivity and marketplace health.
This role is for a data-driven operator who thrives in the "messy reality" of a fast-growing business and can stay calm under the pressure of tight deadlines. You won’t just report numbers; you will own critical planning cadences, manage territory disputes, and troubleshoot process inefficiencies to ensure our sales teams are set up to win. If you have a "roll-up-your-sleeves" mentality and the analytical intuition to find signals in unstructured data, this is where you’ll grow.
 What You’ll Do
Own sales planning and semi-annual quota setting in partnership with Finance to ensure revenue targets and key operating metrics are achieved
Establish and manage complex sales performance dashboards that provide transparency and strategic oversight to global leadership teams
Analyze large sets of unstructured data to evaluate the economics and opportunity costs of programs, driving smarter selection and coverage models
Influence and enforce rules of engagement across selling teams to resolve conflicts around territory assignments and attainment crediting
Develop and maintain SQL-based automations and data tools that streamline workflows and reduce manual effort across the commercial organization
Design and implement scalable pricing or incentive frameworks to optimize deal-making and enhance the bottom line
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Legal to champion strategic projects and deliver data-backed recommendations
 Basic Qualifications
Minimum 5 years of experience in Sales Operations, Business Analytics, Commercial Strategy, or Financial Planning. 
Advanced proficiency in SQL for handling large, unstructured datasets and synthesizing business insights. 
Proven experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau) and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce). 
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Economics, Mathematics, Finance, or Business Administration. 
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience within B2B, SaaS, or consumption-based marketplace businesses. 
Strong project management skills with the ability to lead multiple competing workstreams using tools like Asana or JIRA. 
Knowledge of Python, R, or ETL processes to further automate and scale reporting solutions. 
Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and C-level executives. 
English and French would be a nice to have as this role would be covering France. 
 Ready to Ride?
 This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

 Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology. Founded in 2003, we help communications teams around the world drive awareness, make smarter decisions, and protect their reputation when it matters most. Our enterprise-grade platform unifies media relations, media monitoring, social listening, AI visibility, and media intelligence into a single seamless system—turning overwhelming streams of coverage and conversation into decision-ready intelligence. Recognized for ease of use, results, and customer support, Agility is one of the most trusted names in media intelligence. Our mission is to empower the voices that shape the world's narratives, and we're looking for people who want to help us do it.

Introduction:
As a Sales Operations Manager on our Revenue Operations Team, you are the dedicated operational backbone driving high performance across our global (EMEA/US) Sales team. You own the tools our SDRs and AEs work in, you’ll continuously refine the processes that carry a deal from first touch to close, and the data our leadership forecasts from. You also integrate AI into the sales cycle to take sales efficiency to the next level, making selling faster and smarter at every stage.
What you will be doing:
Sales workflow & continuous enhancement: You own the operational design of the sales lifecycle, from territory and account assignment logic to sales methodology and processes that ensure seamless, effective, scalable handoff from Sales to Client Development.
Sales tech stack: You are the product owner for the tools our SDR and Account Executive teams rely on every day, from Salesforce and Gong to our sales engagement and lead research systems like ZoomInfo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. You partner closely with our Tech team to turn what Sales needs into workable solutions, and you own the path from scoping and prioritization through testing, documentation, and adoption.
Reporting and forecasting: You evolve the reporting infrastructure our team runs on, from the pipeline generation and outreach analytics our SDR and AE teams work in day to day to the forecasting leadership relies on. You turn that data into a clear read on how we are tracking against plan, surfacing the risks and opportunities our sales leadership needs to act on.
AI along the demand & sales process: You bring AI into how we prospect and sell, from proposal creation to deal scoring, identifying where automation can take work off the team's plate and where better signals can sharpen how we sell. You shape these opportunities into concrete solutions together with our Tech team and AI Automation Engineer, and you own their rollout and adoption.
Data integrity: You safeguard the quality of our opportunity and pipeline data, from the input processes upstream to working with the RevOps team to automate the recurring routines that keep records clean.
Collaboration: You coordinate across Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and our client-facing teams, keeping everyone aligned on the processes and data you own.
Who you are:
You have 3+ years of hands-on Sales Operations experience, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.
Hands-on with the sales tech stack: You are a genuine Salesforce power-user who builds your own reports and dashboards, and you have owned other parts of the sales tech stack e.g. Gong, ZoomInfo, Salesloft.
Data-driven and analytical: You have a proven ability to build reports and translate complex data into insights people can act on, and you have built or improved forecasting infrastructure.
Fluent with AI and automation: You use AI tools daily for real productivity gains, and you have a good instinct for where automation helps along a sales process and where it does not.
Meticulously detail-orientated: You have a high bar for accuracy and understand that data integrity, clean records, and getting the small things right are what keep everything else running.
An autonomous and curious owner: You are proactive and resourceful, with a "doer" mentality and the ability to take projects from initial scoping to full adoption. You ask why before how, and you are genuinely interested in how systems fit together.
An excellent communicator and collaborator: You articulate complex ideas clearly and can steer stakeholder discussions where interests are not aligned, such as a handover between sales and client-facing teams. You thrive in an open, feedback-driven culture.
Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
Benefits of working at quantilope:
Wellness is key: We offer private health insurance with Vitality, a cash back plan, travel insurance for all your trips as well as regular mental health training, and the support of certified mental health first aiders. We also have our quantiwell days which are global mental health days once a quarter where the whole company takes a day for themselves.
Flexible work environment: With flexible PTO, flexible working hours and remote/hybrid opportunities, we believe you can succeed from anywhere. Did we mention that everyone has the opportunity to work abroad for up to 6 weeks per year?
Planning for the future: At quantilope, we keep your financial wellness top of mind with Nest Pension Plan.
Team Bonding: Team offsites, summer and holiday parties, global retreats..where in the world will we bring the team together next? We’re all working hard and know how important it is to have fun along the way. 
Ongoing learning: With our dedicated learning budget for every employee and company-wide workshops with the best in the biz, we believe in providing our employees with all the tools they need to excel.
 About Us
 Meet quantilope: Great people, innovative technology, and the foundation to create an impact. quantilope automates consumer research with AI-driven solutions to support data-driven decision making. Founded in 2014, we're recognized for our innovation and rapid growth. quantilope provide insights in brand awareness, market segmentation, advertising testing, product concepts, pricing analysis, and more for 300+ brands.
As a consumer research technology company, we know the importance of diversity not only in our data but also across our team. At quantilope, we celebrate and welcome all people regardless of their gender identity, age, sexual orientation, race, religion, or ethnicity. We strongly believe that best ideas come from sharing and collaborating across diverse perspectives and experiences.
Join us and let's see what we can build together!

Competencies 
You are an applied AI engineer whose product is the revenue engine. You find where the customer lifecycle can work better and ship production-grade agentic workflow, LLM pipelines and integrations that make each process best in class for reps, CSMs and marketers. You operate independently and own each build end to end: architecture, prototype, evals, deployment and observability. You spar on solution design with the team, then ship.
We care more about what you have shipped than where you studied. If you have built something real, show us.
 Must-haves 
 You have shipped AI systems GTM teams use daily. Agents, workflows or integrations used by sales, CS or marketing that moved a number.
 Strong integration skills in JavaScript or TypeScript. You’re comfortable building and running integration services. Working with APIs and webhooks, handling auth, rate limits and errors, and shipping tested code.
 Hands-on Salesforce or equivalent, declarative and code. Declarative: object model, Flows, validation rules, permission sets, record types. Code: Apex triggers and classes, SOQL and SOSL, Lightning Web Components, Platform Events and Change Data Capture, REST and Bulk APIs, SFDX deployments.
 Applied AI engineering. You build with LLM APIs, not just chat interfaces, and can show the skills listed below in real work.
 You understand the revenue engine. Experience in RevOps, GTM Systems, growth or a GTM engineering agency in B2B SaaS. You know how pipeline, renewals and expansion actually work.
 Data quality fundamentals. SQL, CRM data models, deduplication, enrichment waterfalls and data quality at scale.
 GTM data stack. Clay, n8n, Make + warehouse and reverse ETL experience.
 Production mindset. You ship fast and build things others can maintain: logged, monitored, documented.
 Clear communicator. You can sit with a top rep, find the work that shouldn't exist, and explain the fix in plain words.
 Nice-to-haves 
Experience with a customer platform or CSM tool (Planhat, Gainsight, ChurnZero), or HubSpot alongside Salesforce.
Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I or II, or Platform App Builder.
Side projects, open-source tools, public write-ups or a GitHub that shows you build for fun.
Founder, agency or early-stage startup experience.
 Trajectory 
You’ll own each build end to end, from architecture and prototype through evals, deployment and observability. Here’s what that looks like:
 Agentic GTM workflows: Design and ship AI agents and workflows that optimise productivity: account research, signal detection, enrichment, call and email analysis, personalised outreach, renewal and expansion plays.
 Planhat on Planhat: Run our own GTM on our own platform. Build with Planhat's AI, automations and APIs, and feed what you learn straight back to Product as a power user.
 Signals and data: Turn product usage, intent, firmographic and conversation data into scores and triggers that route the right account to the right person at the right time.
 Integrations: Connect tools that don't talk natively. Build the webhooks, MCP connection and transformations that keep data clean across the stack.
 Build vs buy: Run tight pilots on new GTM and AI tools, measure fit and ROI, and make a clear call.
 Enablement: Document what you build, teach teams to use it with confidence, and raise how the whole company builds with AI.
 Definition of Success 
Success is measured in outcomes: productivity gains, pipeline acceleration, data quality and adoption of what you ship.

 About Float 
Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth. 
As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies and top-rated startups in 2025 , 2024 and 2023 , Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.
At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.
 Our Product 
Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C , and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.
Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.
 AI Use in Our Hiring Process 
We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. Evaluate, implement, and optimize the acquisition tech stack (sales engagement, Salesforce pipeline configuration), driving adoption across BDR and AE teams.
Own pipeline health: coverage ratios, stage conversion, win/loss analysis
Build and own forecasting and quota-setting for sales-acquired TPV, and partner with Marketing Ops on the self-serve-to-sales handoff.
Build scalable territory and account-assignment programs for BDR/AE capacity.
Partner with BDR/AE leadership on reporting cadences, monetization levers (e.g. contract terms), operating rhythms, and performance metrics.
Own streamlining handoffs from Marketing > BDR, BDR > AE, and AE to Customer Activation teams
Translate fragmented pipeline and activation data into recommendations for Sales and GTM leadership.
Identify and automate manual

We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.
